cross_section_note_zh: 全带横断面自西向东为：西侧街区带(约341米)—西缝隙(约68米)—遗址公园主廊(约205米)—东缝隙(约85米)—东侧街区带(约495米)。
cross_section_note_en: West to east the belt section reads: western block band (~341 m), west seam (~68 m), heritage park spine (~205 m), east seam (~85 m), eastern block band (~495 m).
coverage_note_zh: 仅绘制方案提出的关键体量，不是现状建筑普查，因此建筑基底率显著低于真实建成区。
coverage_note_en: Only the key volumes proposed by the scheme are drawn. This is not a survey of the existing stock, so the footprint ratio is far below that of a real built-up area.
